thread:
Maya CS: Heads up — Satori onboarding batch enroll p95 rose from ~95ms to ~220ms in last 24h. Renewal touch tomorrow and their usage looks flat; want to run a proactive perf canary to demonstrate improvements. Proposal: int8 quant canary + route 10% to dedicated pool. Need ops + eng + customer consent.

Adarsh RM: Sounds reasonable. Did our eval harness show any regressions on Satori's prompt set?

Maya CS: Very small — model-checker shows ~0.7% detokenize diffs on rare edge examples. Not in main flows. Plan: 10% canary with auto-fallback to fp16 on mismatch.

Jin Eng: I can build int8-v2 artifact and wire up a traffic-split rollout. Will include fallback and monitoring hooks. What targets do we want?

Lucas SRE: I can reserve a tiny dedicated pool in us-west-2 tonight 02:00-04:00 UTC for the window and enable request tracing.

Eve PM: Product wants a one-pager for Satori describing perf gains, safety net, and how to opt out. Also short in-app feedback post-canary. Keep messaging: measurable perf + automatic rollback.

Maya CS: Proposed canary plan:
1) produce quant artifact named int8-v2
2) route 10% traffic to int8-v2 on dedicated pool
3) monitor p95, token-loss, detokenize-errors for 6h
4) if QoE delta <1% and p95 <120ms, ramp to 100% within 24h
Approve?

Jin Eng: Approve. Rollout snippet: 
```
route_policy: {
  traffic_split: {"int8-v2": 0.1, "fp16-v1": 0.9},
  fallback: "fp16-v1",
  monitor: ["p95","token-loss","detokenize-errors"]
}
```

Adarsh RM: @Maya CS I'll draft a short renewal note highlighting perf uplift and our mitigation checklist for procurement.

Lucas SRE: Alerts: token-loss >0.5% OR p95 regression >20% => immediate rollback. I'll also add a temporary capacity-boost toggle.

redwood-bot: Canary job scheduled: canary-4444 at 2026-04-12T02:00Z by Jin Eng

Maya CS: I'll request consent from Satori with this text: 'We will run a brief performance canary with automatic rollback if quality impact is detected.' Will log consent in account thread.

Adarsh RM: Sent consent + attached rollback checklist to customer.

Jin Eng: Will post canary logs to #eng-runtime and notify owners on any regression. Aim to capture >=500 requests per variant for confidence.

Maya CS: Also coordinating an in-app micro-survey for affected sessions to capture subjective feedback.

Eve PM: No objections from product. Proceed when canary is scheduled. :thumbsup: 

Lucas SRE: Approved.

Adarsh RM: Approved.

Jin Eng: Approved.

Maya CS: Approved. Kicking off artifact build and scheduling the window; will report results and customer response after run.
